ruleDefinitions.name: Kernel Memory Dump Via LiveKD
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of LiveKD with the "-m" flag to potentially dump the kernel memory

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\livekd\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\livekd64\\\.exe$")) OR process_original_file_name = "livekd\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-m.*"))
